nieuw.titel: Pursue with one attacker and reform the other
nieuw.tekst: After a combined charge breaks an enemy unit, use one attacker to run it down and reform the other to threaten the rest of the enemy army's flanks.
nieuw.waarom: He says this creates a break in the enemy line that forces the opponent to manoeuvre to face your units or let them run riot.

aanvullingen.voorbeeld: He describes a long charge where only one of two intended attackers reaches armoured Dwarf Warriors or Longbeards, leaving it caught in a grinding fight even if it wins the first round.
aanvullingen.toelichting: He warns against charges that leave cavalry grinding against a resilient unit instead of breaking through on impact.

bron.citaat: the placement of that night unit as a tactical reserve

extraCitaten.citaat: a unit of inner circle Knight was able then to counter attack

aanvullingen.voorbeeld: In an eighth-edition game, his State Troops took an attack from what he recalls as Witch Elves, inflicted some casualties and fled. Inner Circle Knights held in reserve then counterattacked and, with some good fortune, broke through.
aanvullingen.toelichting: He credits cavalry held as a tactical reserve with responding to an infantry defeat and turning the battle.

overgeslagen: Skipped the contact-sport analogy, introductory rules explanations, closing channel promotion and the old battle's result. Used the eighth-edition anecdote only as his example of a cavalry reserve.
